metadata.title: AdSpace Market - B2B Advertising Space Platform
metadata.description: B2B marketplace for booking, deploying and managing the finances of OOH/DOOH advertising spaces.

footer.tagline: B2B platform for managing and booking OOH/DOOH advertising space.

landing.title: Digitize the booking and rollout of your advertising campaigns
landing.subtitle: AdSpace Market connects advertisers, media agencies and billboard owners on a single platform: real-time availability, secure payment and on-site proof of performance.

map.title: Interactive map
map.description: Browse billboard owners' OOH and DOOH inventory on a multi-city, multi-country map.

booking.title: Booking & delegation
booking.description: Build your campaign and pay directly, or delegate the purchase to your media agency.

payment.title: Automated payment
payment.description: Funds escrow and automatic split between commissions and billboard owners.

pop.title: Proof of performance (P.O.P)
pop.description: Track on-site rollout with geolocated, timestamped photos.
